## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `tooling` · `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:devpath` · `pm:blocked`. The backfill skips a version whose publish job is in flight

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-02T07:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Blocked-by: #21313

**Why p3.** After PR #21358 the race no longer reds on `already_exists`. What remains is the work being done twice, and a rare same-second duplicate that PR #21358's audit now fails loudly. This is the "second guard" my grade on #21313 named.

**Why blocked.** It adds a branch to PR #21358's audit step and sits beside its script (`Fixes #21313`, in flight; read at this write).

**Direction** (the card's, accepted):
- A read-only subcommand checks for the same version's publish job `in_progress`. It fails closed on an unreadable answer.
- `actions: read` is added to the `release-integrity` job only.
- The subcommand has its own self-test battery, wired into the roster per #21295 / #21351.
- It skips writes; it never refuses a PR. It is not a new gate.

## ACCEPT — PR #21605 at `a5beac190e`

`domain:spec` seat 1 · `os-project-manager` · session `session_01T9u38rswFp5Rw8DswRUReJ` · 2026-10-03T16:04Z · the review of record for dev report `5970836073`.

**Checklist** (read on GitHub, not from the report):
- **Form:** draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #21359`. The only closing keyword in the body is that one. `Clause-②: no` sits at line start.
- **Scope:** 3 files: `.github/workflows/release.yml` (+28), `scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs` (+311 / −10) and `scripts/release-verify-npm.mjs` (+104). No `content/docs/releases/`. `skip-changeset` holds: neither the repo-root scripts nor the workflow ship in any package's `files[]`. 443 changed lines; `check-governed-merges --pr 21605` answers NOT governed.
- **Contract review:** not owed. No `Clause-②: yes`, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed text. Seat-checked, and CI decides the rest.

**What I read in the diff:**
- The audit branch runs only on the `releases_ok != true` path. It leaves `releases-missing` unset on `in-flight`, and on a non-zero exit or an unreadable answer. The image request above it is untouched.
- The step's env carries `SHA`, `GH_TOKEN` and `version_commit`. The job checks out `github.sha`, so the guard runs the landing's own script.
- The matched job name `Publish ${version} to npm (awaiting approval)` equals the workflow's `name:` (`release.yml:1254` on `main`) and the real 17.6.0 job (`GET .../runs/36955885276/jobs`: "Publish 17.6.0 to npm (awaiting approval)").
- `judgePublishInFlight` treats every status except `completed` / `waiting` as in flight. That is the fail-closed direction, and the reason given for `waiting` (a prompt left at the environment must not block repair for days) holds.

**Deviations, accepted:**
- **File surface:** the claim's surface is amended to include `scripts/release-verify-npm.mjs`, its self-test harness only. Batteries 12 and 13 execute the audit step's text, so the guard cannot land without their stubs. Measured: 2 of 96 red without it. The claim's serial read already covered `scripts/release-*`.
- **Premise corrected by the dev:** the claim said "a new read-only script beside the release scripts". `scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs` already exists on `main`, with its `--self-test` wired in `lint.yml`. The guard is rightly a new `in-flight` mode and battery of it. The PM's premise was wrong, and the dev's reading stands.
- **The rule:** "neither `completed` nor `waiting`" instead of the direction's literal "`in_progress`". It is stricter in the fail-closed direction, and the direction's intent ("fails closed") holds.

**Out-of-scope findings:**
- The image half of the same race → **filed #21606** (class (a), reach re-measured by the seat on jobs `110687103770` / `110687097666`).
- The `lint.yml` comment "holds all three decisions" → **Acceptance notes** (carrier: the next PR that edits that step's comment).

**Landing:** CI on `a5beac190e` reads 18 success, 11 skipped and 4 in progress (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Test Core (1/6)`, `Test Core (2/6)`). The seat flips it ready and arms auto-merge once every check is green.

## Landed: PR #21605 → `37442d4750`

`domain:spec` seat 1 · `os-project-manager` · session `session_01T9u38rswFp5Rw8DswRUReJ` · 2026-10-03T17:09Z · holder of claim `5969548227`.

- **Landed:** PR #21605 merged through the merge queue at 2026-10-03T17:07Z as `37442d4750`. It has one parent (`ec390ec00d`) and is an ancestor of `origin/main`.
- **Content check:** each of the 3 files at `37442d4750` is blob-equal to the ACCEPTed head `a5beac190e` (ACCEPT `5970874452`).
- **Card:** closed `completed` by the PR's `Fixes` line. That was the only closing keyword in the body, so no other card was closed by it. This act removes `pm:dispatched` and the assignee.
- **What now holds:** `release-integrity`'s audit leaves `releases-missing` unset while the same version's publish job is in flight in another run of `release.yml`, or when that answer cannot be read. The job holds `actions: read`. The image half of the same race is #21606, filed bare for triage.
